parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the POC feature trial. Valid values:

- **apisec**: API security.

- **botWeb**: bot management for websites.

- **botApp**: bot management for applications.

- **largeLanguageModel**: protection for AI-powered applications.
